subject: general
question: Which of the following musical instruments is not Indo-Islamic in origin?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Veena**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The veena **also spelt **vina**, comprises **various chordophone instruments **from the **Indian subcontinent.**
 
• **Ancient musical instruments **evolved into **many variations**, such as **lutes, zithers, and arched harps.**
 
• **Veena **is a **musical instrument **that is **not Indo-Islamic in origin**.
 
• **One who plays **the **veena **is **referred **to as **a vainika.**
 
• It **remains **an **important and popular string instrument **in **classical Carnatic music**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sitar **is a **stringed instrument **of the **lute family **that is **popular in northern India, Pakistan, and Bangladesh**. 
 
• **Rubab, robab, or rabab **is a **flute-like musical instrument**. The rubab is **one of the national musical instruments of Afghanistan**; and is also **commonly used in Pakistan**.
 
• **A tabla **is a **pair of twin hand drums **from the **Indian subcontinent**. Since the **18th century**, it has been the **principal percussion instrument in Hindustani classical music**, where it may be played solo, as an accompaniment with other instruments and vocals, and as a part of larger ensembles.
